Selected Research

The Lift Spectrum · Robust image-free sensingPreprint

arXiv · 2026 · Paper · Code

•Showed that, without reconstruction, the 1D-to-2D lift is the design problem; mapped the lift spectrum.

•Proposed STSF + TPLS: +3.2–9.9 mIoU over the prior image-free method (SPIFS); near-constant accuracy down to 0.78% sampling; up to +21.7 mIoU over clean-trained reconstruct-then-segment at 20 dB noise.

Sparse Hadamard single-pixel imaging

Optics Express · 2025 · Paper · Code

•Introduced tunable sparsity into orthogonal Hadamard patterns: noise-robust imaging through scattering, low-order matrices that save memory, no training or post-processing.

LDGI · Optical phased-array imaging

Optics Communications · 2025 · Paper · Code

•Showed that line patterns from one-dimensional optical phased arrays break the noise symmetry of ghost-imaging denoising; proposed LDGI (orders-of-magnitude gains), validated optically.
